The cost of diesel fuel varies depending on several factors, such as the current price at the pump, the mileage of your vehicle, and the driving conditions. As of my knowledge cutoff in September 2019, the average price of diesel fuel in Oklahoma was around $2.80 per gallon.
According to the US Department of Energy, the fuel economy of a 2014 Volkswagen Passat TDI is around 34 miles per gallon (mpg) on the highway and 23 mpg in the city. Let's assume that you will be driving 75 miles, which is half highway and half city driving, and that you will use 1/2 tank of diesel fuel.
The distance between Edmond and Wetumka is approximately 135 miles.
To calculate the fuel cost, we will use the following formula:
Gallons needed = miles ÷ mpg
Gallons needed = 135 ÷ 34
Gallons needed = 4.028 gallons
Cost per gallon = price per gallon
Cost per gallon = $2.80
Total cost = gallons needed × cost per gallon
Total cost = 4.028 gallons × $2.80
Total cost = $11.28
This is just an estimate, and the actual cost may vary depending on several factors.
